question: Do the already selected candidate-cycle local input waveforms substantially exceed the frequency range used to calibrate their rate response?
observable: DC-removed one-sided Parseval power per input channel; strict frequency greater than cutoff; no mixing of channel units
statistical_unit: One deterministic local input waveform at each of four previously selected populations; no replicate or whole-network inference
scope: Read-only diagnosis of spectral coverage on the old 1 mm conditional periodic candidate. Raw variance intensities are NOT the variance after synaptic filtering. Input power outside the fit range is not response-weighted output error, does not prove a cause of closure mismatch, does not repair the model and does not classify onset. No fitting or new simulations. Analytic two-frequency and Nyquist checks required.
